name: Mikazuki Yuuka
source:
The female president of the company Takurou works at. She is a brilliant and intelligent older woman who has all qualities required of being president.

 She is strict with herself and kind to others. She can be quite harsh on Takurou when his work is not going well, unbeknownst to her, this has the opposite effect on him.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
